name.value: Swift Brewing & Good Time Tasting Room

description.value: Swift Brewing & Good Time Tasting Room occupies a heritage building at Victoria Harbour that has stood since 1894, serving successive lives as a power plant, welding shop, and grain warehouse before becoming a brewery. The taproom pours house-crafted beers alongside cocktails and snacks in a retro-basement aesthetic, and operates a patio that welcomes pets. Canned beers are available to take away, making it a handy stop for cyclists passing through the harbour area.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 12m; rack at 14m; stands (2 spaces) at 32m; stands (2 spaces) at 33m; stands (2 spaces) at 34m; stands (2 spaces) at 34m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at swiftbrewing.ca is fully accessible and confirms an active craft brewery and taproom at 450 Swift Street, Victoria BC, matching the OSM record. The Our Beers page explicitly lists canned beers available 'to go,' confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: The /menu/ subpage contains what appears to be a typo — it lists '2450 Swift Street' rather than '450 Swift Street' shown consistently everywhere else on the site.
No phone number is present in either the OSM record or the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active craft brewery and taproom confirmed by a fully populated website. A practical stop for touring cyclists in the Victoria Harbour area.
